I am a woman farmer here in the North West. This small plot of 0.29 hectares I planted with beans mixed with other crops, because beans help the soil and my family needs the food. I cannot afford much chemical fertilizer, but I will put a little on the cereal I intercrop, and I use the manure from our small animals on this land. I keep my own seed from last harvest like my mother taught me, and me and my children will do most of the work ourselves. When weeding time is heavy, I will call two or three people to help for a few days.
